panel: Use case: product-mockup. Production cockpit texture for a desktop flight simulator, landscape 16:9. Original photorealistic Airbus A320-inspired CAPTAIN'S instrument panel viewed nearly straight-on from the pilot's seat with slight natural perspective. Cool blue-grey painted metal, authentic-looking screws, black-glass displays, tactile black/grey knobs, subtle wear, soft daylight from upper left, high photographic material fidelity. Only dashboard and forward side consoles; no sky, windows, canopy, exterior scenery, human or game UI. Four large blank black rectangular display interiors across upper middle: captain PFD x=9%-26%,y=16%-54%, captain navigation display x=29%-46%,y=16%-54%, engine display x=51%-68%,y=16%-54%, system display x=71%-88%,y=16%-54%. Each has a convincing physical bezel. Autopilot/FCU panel is a narrow band across top y=1%-12%, with unlit small windows and physical knobs, no fabricated bright numbers. Three blank circular standby instrument bezels centred at x=40%,50%,60%, y=65%, radius about 3% image width. Left captain side-stick rubber boot at x=7%,y=83%, mount only NO grip. Central twin-engine throttle quadrant at x=58%, y=85%, two visible tracks and mount only, NO throttle handles. Lower central pedestal has realistic radio and flight-management keys with blank glass windows, static engraved lettering, no active readings. No military joystick in the middle, no yoke, no artificial green HUD, no airline logos. Functional blank instruments for live software overlays. Original A320-style artwork, not copied game assets or a certified 1:1 cockpit.
grips: Use case: product-mockup. Transparent two-cell control sprite atlas for an original Airbus A320-inspired CAPTAIN'S flight simulator panel. Landscape 2:1, real transparent background, each object fully contained in its own equal cell, generous transparent padding. LEFT cell: photorealistic civil airliner TWIN-ENGINE THROTTLE HANDLES together as a single isolated assembly: two matching light-grey/black ergonomic thrust levers side by side with small engine numerals 1 and 2 and small reverse-thrust triggers, short lower mounting stalks, no pedestal/base. RIGHT cell: photorealistic Airbus-style CAPTAIN side-stick grip, simple compact contoured matte black handle, small red autopilot-disconnect pushbutton and understated trim trigger, no military four-way hats or weapon buttons, short mount pointing down, no base. Same apparent object height, pilot-seated downward perspective, fine realistic rubber and painted plastic wear, subtle daylight from upper left matching blue-grey civilian panel. No people, hands, cockpit, scenery, yoke, joystick base, game logos, decorative captions, watermark, active readings or opaque background.
usage: Original style-inspired panel artwork, not copied game imagery or a certified cockpit reproduction.
